private_submission_state.name: private_submission_state
private_submission_state.value: "private_application_submission"."state" in ('intent','unknown','submitted') and ("private_application_submission"."state" != 'submitted' or "private_application_submission"."submitted_at" is not null)

private_application_lease.name: private_application_lease
private_application_lease.value: ("private_application"."lease_until" is null and "private_application"."lease_checked_at" is null) or ("private_application"."lease_until" is not null and "private_application"."lease_checked_at" is not null and "private_application"."fence" > 0 and "private_application"."lease_until" > "private_application"."lease_checked_at" and "private_application"."state" in ('screening','tailoring','filling','ready','submitting','submission_unknown'))

private_application_attempt.name: private_application_attempt
private_application_attempt.value: typeof("private_application"."attempt") = 'integer' and "private_application"."attempt" > 0 and (("private_application"."attempt" = 1 and "private_application"."previous_application_id" is null) or ("private_application"."attempt" > 1 and "private_application"."previous_application_id" is not null))

private_application_snapshot.name: private_application_snapshot
private_application_snapshot.value: ("private_application"."snapshot_manifest_id" is null and "private_application"."snapshot_target_key" is null and "private_application"."snapshot_hash" is null) or ("private_application"."snapshot_manifest_id" is not null and "private_application"."snapshot_target_key" is not null and "private_application"."snapshot_hash" is not null and length("private_application"."snapshot_hash") = 64)

private_manifest_progress.name: private_manifest_progress
private_manifest_progress.value: "private_discovery_manifest"."candidate_count" between 0 and 10000 and "private_discovery_manifest"."staged_count" between 0 and "private_discovery_manifest"."candidate_count" and "private_discovery_manifest"."revision" > 0 and "private_discovery_manifest"."state" in ('staging','ready','abandoned') and ("private_discovery_manifest"."state" != 'ready' or "private_discovery_manifest"."staged_count" = "private_discovery_manifest"."candidate_count")

private_target_identity.name: private_target_identity
private_target_identity.value: ("private_discovery_target"."ats" is null and "private_discovery_target"."tenant" is null and "private_discovery_target"."requisition" is null) or ("private_discovery_target"."ats" is not null and "private_discovery_target"."tenant" is not null and "private_discovery_target"."requisition" is not null)

private_document_hash_check.name: private_document_hash_check
private_document_hash_check.value: "private_document"."sha256" is null or (length("private_document"."sha256") = 64 and "private_document"."sha256" not glob '*[^a-f0-9]*')

private_manual_identity_check.name: private_manual_identity_check
private_manual_identity_check.value: ("private_manual_application_mark"."ats" is null and "private_manual_application_mark"."tenant" is null and "private_manual_application_mark"."requisition" is null) or ("private_manual_application_mark"."ats" is not null and "private_manual_application_mark"."tenant" is not null and "private_manual_application_mark"."requisition" is not null)

private_policy_acceptance_check.name: private_policy_acceptance_check
private_policy_acceptance_check.value: ("private_policy_head"."enabled" = 0 and "private_policy_head"."accepted_policy_version" is null and "private_policy_head"."accepted_policy_hash" is null and "private_policy_head"."accepted_at" is null) or ("private_policy_head"."enabled" = 1 and "private_policy_head"."accepted_policy_version" = "private_policy_head"."policy_version" and "private_policy_head"."accepted_policy_hash" is not null and "private_policy_head"."accepted_at" is not null)

private_answer_reuse_check.name: private_answer_reuse_check
private_answer_reuse_check.value: "private_question_answer"."reuse" in ('application','employer','equivalent') and ("private_question_answer"."reuse" = 'application' or "private_question_answer"."meaning_review_id" is not null)
